description: Absent by default (permissive core). A tenant that wants export-quality training data for this profile creates/edits this file to opt in - see labels_row_shape (reason_text) and agent_draft_present (agent_draft) in src/ap_gate/checks/labels.py. This reference profile ships the file present but both flags OFF so the gold-pack example stays representative of core (non-training-grade) usage; flip to true to see the stricter behavior.
